lots.title: Inspection & Maintenance of Indoor Gymnasium, Fitness & Sport Equipment and Outdoor Schools Play & Sport Equipment (ESPO Framework 107_26 Call-Off)
lots.description: Single non-lotted call-off arrangement under ESPO Framework Agreement reference 107_26 between Leicestershire County Council (trading as ESPO) and an appointed Supplier for the provision of inspection & maintenance of indoor gymnasium, fitness & sport equipment and outdoor schools play & sport equipment services to Contracting Authorities (Customers) under the Procurement Act 2023 (PA23). The supplied document is a Form of Contract and Call-Off Terms template (Framework Schedule 3); detailed Goods/Services specifications, performance/delivery locations, milestones, charges, technical standards and any further-competition evaluation criteria are placeholders to be completed at call-off and are externally incorporated from Framework Agreement Schedule 1 (Specification) and the ESPO Invitation to Tender Section 2 (Requirement).
requirements: Supplier shall comply with the Technical Standards and the Quality Standards specified in the Master Contract Schedule and clause 13 of the Framework Agreement, and where applicable maintain accreditation with the relevant authorisation body (clause 6.3.1).
Supplier shall ensure Goods are free from defects in design and workmanship and are fit for purpose, and supplied in accordance with the Supplier Solution (clauses 6.3.5.1, 6.3.5.2).

Supplier shall supply the Goods and/or Services in accordance with the Specification (as a minimum), the Master Contract Schedule and applicable Law including obligations implied by sections 12, 13 and 14 of the Sale of Goods Act 1979 and section 2 of the Supply of Goods and Services Act 1982 (clause 6.3.4).
Supplier shall maintain business continuity arrangements throughout the Contract Period and review them at appropriate intervals so that delivery is subject to a minimum of disruption (clause 8.1).

Supplier shall achieve or exceed the Service Levels set out in Schedule 1 Part A; failures attract Service Credits and a Critical Service Failure entitles the Customer to terminate (clauses 11.1, 9.1; Schedule 1 Part A para 1).
Supplier shall implement measurement and monitoring tools and procedures sufficient to verify compliance with the Service Levels (clause 11.2).
Supplier shall comply with the monitoring arrangements and provide Management Information referred to in the Master Contract Schedule (clauses 9.1, 9.2).
Supplier shall provide an Implementation Plan and meet each Milestone by the Milestone Date; missed Milestones attract Delay Payments (Schedule 2 paras 1, 2).

Supplier shall comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and any other applicable health and safety acts, orders, regulations and codes of practice (clause 25.4); promptly notify health and safety hazards and incidents (clauses 25.1, 25.3).

Supplier shall operate a suitable environmental management system and minimise GHG emissions, comply with applicable environmental Law and submit an annual GHG/sustainability report using the most recent government conversion factors (clauses 26.2-26.5).
Supplier shall not commit Prohibited Acts under the Bribery Act 2010 and shall maintain an anti-bribery policy; on request, certify annual compliance (clauses 27.1.2, 27.3.1, 27.3.4, 27.3.5).

Supplier and Customer shall comply with Data Protection Legislation including UK GDPR; controller/processor or independent/joint controller roles, processing details and DPO contacts to be set out in Section 9 of the Master Contract Schedule (Master Contract Schedule §9; clauses 16.9 series).
Supplier shall comply with PA23 transparency obligations and consent to publication of Transparency Information except where exempt under FOIA, EIR or PA23 (clauses 18.56.1, 18.56.2).

Equipment brought onto Premises is at the Supplier's own risk; Supplier shall maintain Equipment in safe, serviceable and clean condition and remove or replace items deemed hazardous, noxious or non-compliant (clauses 6.2.3, 6.2.4, 6.2.5).
Where the Warranty Period applies, Supplier shall remedy defects in Goods notified during or shortly after the Warranty Period free of charge (clause 6.5).

If contract value exceeds £5 million, the Customer must set at least three Key Performance Indicators in respect of the Contract pursuant to PA23 sections 52 and 71 (Schedule 1 Appendix to Part A drafting note).
